question: On Nov. 10, 1940, Pittsburgh beat Philadelphia 7-3 without a single penalty called on either team. In all of NFL history, how many games have been completely flag-free?
question_short: An NFL game 86 years ago today had zero penalties. How many flag-free NFL games ever?
answer_detail: The Pro Football Hall of Fame counts only four NFL games with no penalties on either team, all between 1934 and 1940. That Pittsburgh-Philadelphia game at Forbes Field, 86 years ago today, was the last.
answer_short: Only four, all from 1934 to 1940, and none since that 1940 game.
